coordinateSpace: Native FULL TEXTURE pixels, origin upper-left; X right, Y down. cellOrigin/cellSize provided only for conversion.
scope: All20 selected keys. Four opposite-half replacements reviewed separately.
method: Manual anatomical inspection of the original full PNGs and gridded/annotated QA copies. PNG bytes unmodified. Neck and pelvis points were alpha-checked against each exact native source.
use: Production uses only manually reviewed pelvis X to register the intact sprite horizontally. Ground pivot Y, per-source PPU, source paint, UV and material are preserved; neck/pelvis Y remain diagnostic witnesses.
limitations: Back and side pelvis is occluded by cloak; coordinates infer the central waist axis and are not a claim of pixel-exact visible belt anatomy.

The estimates correspond to roughly one imported pixel after ordinary texture downsampling. Hidden pelvisY is too ambiguous for production PPU or vertical-motion calibration; this revision uses pelvisX only.
This registration metadata does not prove support-leg alternation. The separate source-pose correction is the primary fix.

records.pelvisDefinition: Central waist-sash / pelvis axis. Rear and side hidden waists are inferred from torso and leg attachment, not lowest boot.
records.groundBaselineConfidence: high_visible_lowest_support_sole; alpha>=96 gives painted sole bottom, not pelvis-based registration baseline
